_comment: Keeper's Riddle question bank for the Plomp Chronicles bot. Each question is tagged with the chapter it's sourced from so new riddles can be added per chapter drop without touching bot logic. Add/edit freely — the bot just reads this file.

riddles.question: What does The Core choose above all else?
riddles.hint: Chapter I: 'a relic that chose only the worthy.'

riddles.question: How many days did the skies burn during the Black Tide's assault on the Green Order?
riddles.hint: Chapter II opens with this exact number.

riddles.question: What did the Black Tide believe about The Core?
options: It would obey whoever possessed it
riddles.answer: It would obey whoever possessed it
riddles.hint: This belief turned out to be wrong — The Core had already vanished.

riddles.question: What did the scattered Plompers leave behind before disappearing?
options: Maps to the Isle of Echoes
Glowing marks only another Plomper could recognize
riddles.answer: Glowing marks only another Plomper could recognize
riddles.hint: The Black Tide dismissed these as myths — their greatest mistake.

riddles.question: What did the ancient guardians shatter to protect The Core, rather than the Core itself?
options: The path to The Core (its key)
riddles.answer: The path to The Core (its key)
riddles.hint: The key was divided among Seven Keepers.

riddles.question: Complete the prophecy: 'When seven awaken as one, the path to The Core shall ___.'
riddles.hint: Spoken by the ancient guardians before the Keepers were scattered.

riddles.question: Among how many Keepers was the key to The Core divided?
riddles.hint: Right there in the chapter title.

riddles.question: What was the recurring message in the Plompers' shared dream?
options: "Find the Seven... before they find you."
"Good... now they can finally find me."
riddles.answer: "Find the Seven... before they find you."
riddles.hint: Repeated across an endless green ocean in every Plomper's dream.

riddles.question: What is the name of the island erased from every map?
riddles.hint: Ships vanish near its waters, and satellites fail overhead.

riddles.question: According to legend, The Core can only be...
riddles.hint: "It couldn't be owned. It couldn't be bought. It could only choose."

riddles.question: How many stone thrones stood at the center of the Isle of Echoes ruins?
riddles.hint: Only one was occupied — by the old guardian.

riddles.question: Finish the guardian's confession: 'The Green Order didn't fall because of the Black Tide... it fell because ___.'
riddles.answer: one of us opened the gate
riddles.hint: The First Betrayal — the enemy was never outside the walls.

riddles.question: What object did the old guardian draw from beneath his cloak?
riddles.hint: Its appearance turned the sea black and cracked the sky with green lightning.

riddles.question: What did the Plompers find inside the ancient chamber instead of gold or a throne?
options: A floating emerald sphere and seven empty pedestals
A sealed door with no way through
riddles.answer: A floating emerald sphere and seven empty pedestals
riddles.hint: The Core wasn't waiting for a king.

riddles.question: What condition must be met before the Seven can unite, according to the voice in the chamber?
options: The Black Tide must be defeated
The False Keeper must be revealed
The Core must fully awaken first
All seven thrones must glow green
riddles.answer: The False Keeper must be revealed
riddles.hint: One pedestal glowed black — the traitor's mark had returned.

riddles.question: Finish the False Keeper's line: 'You've spent all this time searching for The Core... while I've been ___.'
riddles.hint: Spoken the moment the shadow stepped out from the darkness.

riddles.question: What is the name of the floating ancient city revealed in the Core's vision?
riddles.hint: Seven emerald towers surround its central temple.

riddles.question: Which four locations did the path symbols appear in?
riddles.hint: Only six of seven paths appeared — the seventh was missing.

riddles.question: What did the emerald symbols on every Plomper's mark eventually align into?
riddles.hint: This was called the Last Signal.

riddles.question: Complete the False Keeper's final line in Chapter VII: 'Good... now they can finally ___.'
riddles.hint: Spoken from the shadows as the seventh path opened.
